messages.author: 760d13932202d6cf
messages.subject: cursor delay after backslash
parts:
Hi,

I am wondering how I can reduce the cursor delay after backslash '\ ' when I write a latex code e.g.

\section{First section}

I suspect this delay is related to the fact that '\ 'is also used as the <LocalLeader>. I know that I can change it, but how to reduce occurring delay?

Many thanks,
Olga

messages.author: 18092322a527b40b
messages.subject: Re: cursor delay after backslash
parts:
Hello Olga,

One option is to remap the localleader "\".
Add the below to your .vimrc file:

" Remapping key
let maplocalleader = ";"

";" It is more easy to use than "\"

Below (as example) some remapping I use in my .vimrc file:
"------------------------------------------------------------------
" Vim-R-plugin options
"------------------------------------------------------------------
"let vimrplugin_term = "xfce4-terminal"
"let vimrplugin_term = "roxterm"
let vimrplugin_term_cmd = "terminator --title R -x"

" Remapping key
let maplocalleader = ";"
map <F2> :runtime ftplugin/r.vim<CR>  " The main R menu will be always visible to all file extension (only gVim)

if has("gui_running")
  inoremap <C-Space> <C-x><C-o>
else
  inoremap <Nul> <C-x><C-o>
endif

" Remapeamentos e novos mapeamentos do plugin
vmap <Space> <Plug>RDSendSelection
vmap <Space>e <Plug>REDSendSelection
nmap <Space> <Plug>RDSendLine
nmap <LocalLeader><left> :call RSendPartOfLine("left", 0)<CR>
nmap <LocalLeader><right> :call RSendPartOfLine("right", 0)<CR>
nmap <C-l> :call RClearConsole()<CR>

map <silent> <LocalLeader>h :call RAction("head")<CR>
map <silent> <LocalLeader>t :call RAction("tail")<CR>
map <silent> <LocalLeader>q :call RAction("str")<CR>
map <silent> <LocalLeader>p :call RAction("dput")<CR>
map <silent> <LocalLeader>s :call SendCmdToR("search()")<CR>
map <silent> <LocalLeader>a :call SendCmdToR("ls(a=T)")<CR>

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: cursor delay after backslash
parts:
On Tuesday, December 17, 2013 9:00:54 AM UTC-3, olga30dec wrote:

I am wondering how I can reduce the cursor delay after backslash '\ ' when I write a latex code e.g.

\section{First section}

I suspect this delay is related to the fact that '\ 'is also used as the <LocalLeader>. I know that I can change it, but how to reduce occurring delay?

You can set the value of 'timeoutlen' in your vimrc (the default value is 1000 miliseconds). Example:

set timeoutlen=500


However, as Faria has said, you can also change the key used as <LocalLeader>. I prefer to use a comma as <LocalLeader>:

let maplocalleader = ","
